1-1.text: Part one. Numbers below zero. ... Numbers below zero are negative. A thermometer shows them: negative 4 degrees Celsius means 4 degrees below zero.

1-2.text: On a number line, negative numbers are to the left of zero and positive numbers are to the right.

1-3.text: Numbers get smaller as you go left. Negative 8 is further left than negative 3, so negative 8 is smaller: negative 8 degrees is colder.

1-4.text: From negative 3 degrees to 5 degrees: 3 degrees up to zero, then 5 more. That is 8 degrees warmer.

2-1.text: Part two. Adding and subtracting. ... Adding means moving right on the number line. Negative 2 plus 6: start at negative 2 and hop 6 to the right. You land on 4.

2-2.text: Subtracting means moving left. 3 minus 7: start at 3 and hop 7 to the left. You land on negative 4.

2-3.text: Negative 4 minus 5: start at negative 4 and hop 5 more to the left. You land on negative 9.

3-1.text: Part three. Two signs together. ... Look at this pattern. Each time we take away 1 less, the answer goes up by 1.

3-2.text: So taking away negative 1 gives 7: 6 minus negative 1 equals 6 plus 1. Subtracting a negative is the same as adding.

3-3.text: 6 minus negative 3 equals 6 plus 3, which equals 9.

3-4.text: And adding a negative is the same as subtracting: 5 plus negative 3 equals 5 minus 3, which equals 2.

4-1.text: Part four. Multiplying and dividing. ... To multiply or divide, work out the numbers as normal. Then sort out the sign.

4-2.text: Same signs give a positive answer. Different signs give a negative answer.

4-3.text: Negative 6 times 4 equals negative 24, because the signs are different. Negative 20 divided by negative 5 equals 4, because the signs are the same.

4-4.text: Negative 3, all squared, means negative 3 times negative 3. Same signs, so the answer is 9.

4-5.text: With three numbers, go two at a time: negative 2 times negative 3 equals 6, then 6 times negative 1 equals negative 6.

5-1.text: Part five. Negative numbers in real life. ... A diver is 12 metres below sea level, at negative 12 metres. The diver swims up 5 metres: negative 12 plus 5 equals negative 7. The diver is now 7 metres below sea level.

5-2.text: A bank account has 15 pounds. 22 pounds is spent: 15 minus 22 equals negative 7. The balance is negative 7 pounds, which means 7 pounds is owed to the bank.

5-3.text: What is halfway between negative 6 and 2? The gap is 8. Half of 8 is 4. Negative 6 plus 4 equals negative 2.
